jobs.prompt: Correct original male CLOSE GRIP SMITH BENCH PRESS. Use TRUE SIDE three-quarter view to show bar touches MID/LOWER CHEST at sternum BELOW nipple line, well TOWARD FEET from neck. Shift bench/model relative to VERTICAL guides so bar axis sits at mid/lower chest, NOT throat or face. LEFT bar at chest with elbows tucked alongside ribs and forearms vertical; RIGHT same chest position with arms straight up. NARROW closed OVERHAND grip slightly narrower than shoulder width, not wide, wrists neutral. Both skull/shoulders/buttocks bench supported, feet flat. Red ONLY EXPOSED posterior upper-arm TRICEPS, no biceps/chest/shoulder red. Full opaque BLACK shirt/shorts continuous front sides back seat crotch, fine detailed exposed grayscale anatomy, same limb lengths. Frame connected sliding collars visible, no occlusion of chest/grip if possible. TWO equal square landscape cells white background generous margins, no text.

correctionHistory.prompt: Original ADULT male premium detailed exercise anatomy. TWO equal SQUARE cells side by side WIDE LANDSCAPE. SMITH CLOSE GRIP FLAT BENCH PRESS. Flat horizontal black bench. Hands closed OVERHAND PRONATED grip slightly NARROWER than shoulder width, hand separation about30cm, not touching, wrists straight stacked over forearms. Elbows tucked close alongside ribs. LEFT bar lightly touches MID/LOWER CHEST at sternum BELOW nipple line, NEVER neck/throat. RIGHT bar ABOVE same chest location, arms extended upward. Primary TRICEPS: red highlights on EXPOSED BACKS of upper arms only, no red chest/biceps/shoulders. Realistic Smith machine: horizontal bar ATTACHED to sliding collars on TWO VERTICAL guide rails linked sturdy grounded frame, modest identical weight plates outside hands. Bar slides ONLY vertically, frame/bench/body positions fixed both panels. Camera SIDE-FRONT three-quarter with guide uprights positioned so hands/chest contact visible not occluded. Head IMAGE LEFT feet IMAGE RIGHT in both cells. Back of SKULL DIRECTLY supported bench pad, eyes upward neutral neck, hair swept off pad from beneath skull, head NEVER lifted. Shoulders and buttocks supported pad, both feet soles FLAT floor. Same model scale/limb lengths, generous margins every limb/plate/frame fully contained each cell. Fine detailed grayscale EXPOSED muscle contours arms/calves, realistic proportions, equal male/female detail. Reference original project artwork STYLE ONLY not push-up pose. Fully opaque BLACK shirt and mid-thigh shorts wrap FRONT SIDES BACK SEAT CROTCH with seams/broad folds, no cutaway or anatomy through cloth. Black shoes. White background soft grounded shadows. No embedded text/captions/labels/arrows.
